risk_if_not_implemented: Without Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) (CFG-16) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Configuration Change Control
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the technical configuration change control processes.
compensating_control_2.justification: Configuration Change Control (CHG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) (CFG-16) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
